subject.title: fix(media): apply SSRF guard to byteplus and runway generated video downloads

question: Should BytePlus and Runway generated-video downloads become default-deny for private artifact URLs, with the existing provider request-policy opt-in as the only compatibility path?
rationale: This is the intended SSRF boundary, but it can deliberately stop deployments that previously relied on an implicit private artifact download; only maintainers can accept that upgrade/security tradeoff and the additive SDK surface.

options.title: Accept default-deny behavior
options.body: Approve the guarded helper and retain `models.providers.<id>.request.allowPrivateNetwork` as the explicit compatibility opt-in for private provider artifacts.

options.title: Request a different compatibility policy
options.body: Pause the PR and specify a supported migration or alternative policy if implicit private artifact downloads must remain available by default.

recommendation.title: Accept default-deny behavior
recommendation.body: Approve the guarded helper and retain `models.providers.<id>.request.allowPrivateNetwork` as the explicit compatibility opt-in for private provider artifacts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged sibling work establishes the closest current-main pattern for guarded provider media downloads and request-policy propagation.
